info.name: Event Ticketing Platform
info.description: Multi-tenant ticketing API. Two example tenants are built in: `maxis` and `digi`. First run `Sign-up > Register tenant: maxis` and `Register tenant: digi` (once). Then run `Auth > Login as maxis` or `Auth > Login as digi`: it sets `tenant` and `token`, so every other request goes to that tenant. Switch tenant by running the other login. Webhook calls need `webhook_secret` (see Admin > Settings) and the pre-request script signs the body for you. Every POST/PATCH request lists all the fields its FormRequest accepts, with a per-field table (required/optional, units, rules) in its description. Amounts are integer minor units (sen).

request.description:
Buy tickets for an event. Money is not sent here: prices come from the ticket types (in sen; 5000 = RM 50.00).

| Field | Required? | Type / units | Rules |
|---|---|---|---|
| buyer_name | required | string | max 255 |
| buyer_email | required | string | valid email, max 255 (saved in lowercase) |
| items | required | array | 1 to 20 items; each ticket_type_id may appear only once |
| items[].ticket_type_id | required | integer | min 1; must be a ticket type of this event |
| items[].quantity | required | integer | min 1, max 100 (the ticket type max_per_order may be lower) |
| promo_code | optional | string | max 50; any letter case. Takes money off the ticket subtotal (never below zero); fees stay on the original prices. Errors: promo_code_invalid / promo_code_not_started / promo_code_expired (422), promo_code_exhausted (409) |

Optional header (not in the body): `Idempotency-Key` - 8 to 100 characters, only letters, numbers and `_ - : .`. Send the same key again to safely retry the same checkout.

Other errors: insufficient_stock, event_sold_out (shared event capacity used up), tier_locked (409, the previous tier is not finished yet). Total = subtotal - discount + fees.

Payment provider notification. Signed by the pre-request script (`X-Signature`). Money is in sen.

| Field | Required? | Type / units | Rules |
|---|---|---|---|
| id | required | string | max 100; unique per notification (duplicates are ignored) |
| type | required | string | `payment.succeeded` or `payment.failed` |
| payment_reference | required | string | max 40 |
| amount | required if succeeded, else optional | integer, sen | min 0; must match the order total, discount included (5000 = RM 50.00) |
| currency | required if succeeded, else optional | string | exactly 3 letters, e.g. MYR |
| occurred_at | optional | date-time | ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-11-20T10:15:00Z |

Check in one ticket at the door.

| Field | Required? | Type / units | Rules |
|---|---|---|---|
| code | required | string | ticket code, max 64 |
| gate_name | optional | string | max 60; can be null |

request.description:
Create an event (starts as a draft).

| Field | Required? | Type / units | Rules |
|---|---|---|---|
| title | required | string | max 255 |
| slug | optional | string | max 120; lowercase letters, numbers and single hyphens (e.g. open-mic-night); must be unique. If empty, it is made from the title. Cannot change after the event is published The example adds {{$timestamp}} so it is unique each run; delete the slug line to let the API make one from the title. |
| description | optional | string | max 10000; can be null |
| venue_name | required | string | max 255 |
| venue_address | optional | string | max 500; can be null |
| starts_at | required | date-time | ISO 8601 with offset, e.g. 2027-05-01T20:00:00+08:00 |
| ends_at | required | date-time | ISO 8601 with offset; must be after starts_at |
| capacity | optional | integer | min 1; limit SHARED by all ticket types of the event (null or empty = no limit). Checkout answers event_sold_out when it is used up |

Add a ticket type to an event. Money is in sen.

| Field | Required? | Type / units | Rules |
|---|---|---|---|
| name | required | string | max 255 |
| description | optional | string | max 5000; can be null |
| price_minor | required | integer, sen | 0 to 9999999999. 5000 = RM 50.00. Whole numbers only (no decimals, no text) |
| quantity | required | integer | 1 to 1000000. Cannot be lower than tickets already sold + held |
| max_per_order | optional | integer | 1 to 100; most tickets one order can buy. Default 10 if empty (cannot be null on update) |
| sales_start_at | optional | date-time | ISO 8601 with offset; can be null; must be before sales_end_at and before the event ends_at |
| sales_end_at | optional | date-time | ISO 8601 with offset; can be null; must be after sales_start_at and not later than the event ends_at |
| sort_order | optional | integer | 0 to 65535; display order (cannot be null on update) |
| unlocks_after_ticket_type_id | optional | integer | tier progression: this ticket type opens only after that ticket type is sold out (sold + held) or its sales ended; until then checkout answers tier_locked (409). Same event, not itself, no loops; null removes it. Unsold tickets of the earlier tier are NOT moved to this one |

item.name: Update event (send only the fields to change)

request.description:
PATCH: every field is optional, send only what changes. A published event's slug is frozen. `capacity` below the tickets already sold or held is a 422; `null` clears the limit.

| field | required | type / units | rules |
|---|---|---|---|
| `title` | optional | string | max 255 |
| `venue_name` | optional | string | max 255 |
| `venue_address` | optional | string | max 500 |
| `description` | optional | string | max 10000 |
| `slug` | optional | string | lowercase letters/digits/hyphens, max 120, unique; generated from the title when omitted |
| `starts_at` | optional | ISO-8601 | no offset = tenant timezone |
| `ends_at` | optional | ISO-8601 | after starts_at |
| `capacity` | optional | integer, tickets | min 1. Event-level limit SHARED by all ticket types (null/omitted = none). Checkout answers `event_sold_out` when it is used up |

request.description:
Query parameters (paginated, newest first).

| field | required | type / units | rules |
|---|---|---|---|
| `event_id` | optional | integer | filter |
| `is_active` | optional | boolean | filter |
| `q` | optional | string, max 40 | code prefix, any case |
| `per_page` | optional | integer | 1-100 |
| `page` | optional | integer |  |

Example is a 10 % code. For a fixed code send `"discount_type": "fixed", "amount_minor": 1000` and leave `percent_bps` out.

| field | required | type / units | rules |
|---|---|---|---|
| `code` | required | string, 3-40 | letters, digits, `_` and `-`; stored UPPER-CASE; unique (case-insensitive) |
| `discount_type` | required | `percent` / `fixed` |  |
| `percent_bps` | required if percent | integer, basis points (1000 = 10.00 %) | 1 to 10000; not allowed for `fixed`. Half-up integer rounding on the ticket subtotal |
| `amount_minor` | required if fixed | integer, minor units (sen) | >= 1; not allowed for `percent`. Capped at the ticket subtotal |
| `event_id` | optional | integer | limit to one event; null/omitted = all events of the tenant |
| `max_uses` | optional | integer | 1 to 1000000; null/omitted = unlimited. One use per order; given back when an order expires or fails (not on refund) |
| `starts_at` | optional | ISO-8601 | no offset = tenant timezone |
| `ends_at` | optional | ISO-8601 | after starts_at |
| `is_active` | optional | boolean | default true; set false to retire a used code |

item.name: Update promo code (send only the fields to change)

request.description:
PATCH: every field is optional. Switching `discount_type` needs the matching value in the same request. `max_uses` cannot be below `used` (409 `max_uses_below_used`).

| field | required | type / units | rules |
|---|---|---|---|
| `code` | optional | string, 3-40 | letters, digits, `_` and `-`; stored UPPER-CASE; unique (case-insensitive) |
| `discount_type` | optional | `percent` / `fixed` |  |
| `percent_bps` | optional | integer, basis points (1000 = 10.00 %) | 1 to 10000; not allowed for `fixed`. Half-up integer rounding on the ticket subtotal |
| `amount_minor` | optional | integer, minor units (sen) | >= 1; not allowed for `percent`. Capped at the ticket subtotal |
| `event_id` | optional | integer | limit to one event; null/omitted = all events of the tenant |
| `max_uses` | optional | integer | 1 to 1000000; null/omitted = unlimited. One use per order; given back when an order expires or fails (not on refund) |
| `starts_at` | optional | ISO-8601 | no offset = tenant timezone |
| `ends_at` | optional | ISO-8601 | after starts_at |
| `is_active` | optional | boolean | default true; set false to retire a used code |
Answers 409 `promo_code_in_use` once any use was taken: PATCH `is_active=false` instead.
No body. Answers 202; a queued job writes the CSV and e-mails you a signed download link (30 minutes). Poll **Export status**.
`status`: pending, processing, ready, failed. When `ready` the response carries a fresh temporary signed `download_url`.

item.name: Download the CSV (signed link, no login)

request.description: Uses the signed URL stored by **Export status**; no token or tenant header needed (the tenant is in the path). Invalid or expired: 403 `invalid_signature`.
